provider.readme:
# Qwen — Tongyi Qianwen
Alibaba's open-weight LLM family. The browser bridge drives [chat.qwen.ai](https://chat.qwen.ai) — a free, no-key web chat that exposes Alibaba's latest reasoning + instruct models.
**Why bridge instead of API:** Qwen's official API (DashScope) requires an Alibaba Cloud account with phone verification + Chinese payment methods, which most non-CN users can't satisfy. The web UI works with a regular email signup.
**Models typically exposed** (subject to discovery on first login — Qwen ships new models frequently):
- Qwen3-Max (235B-A22B) — flagship MoE reasoning - Qwen3 (32B / 7B dense) — fast tier - Qwen2.5-Coder — code-specialized
**First-time setup:** the bridge opens chat.qwen.ai in a hidden offscreen WebEngine, GPT-4o handles the signup form (or login if you have an account), then writes the per-session script. After that, every chat is a direct in-page eval — zero API hits.
